description: Change the destination URL, title, or design of an existing editable code. The printed QR and short URL stay the same. This does not work on fixed (non-editable) links. Locked codes must be unlocked first: set `unlock` true and supply `reauthToken` when the app or prior error says reauth is required, or tell the user to unlock in the Qorlie app. Use this only to retarget or restyle an editable code you already have (get the `id` from list_dynamic_qrs). Use create_dynamic_qr to make a new editable code, and deactivate_code to stop the code from redirecting. `id` is required. `destinationUrl` and `title` are the fields to change. `destinationLocked` locks future edits. `designOptions` and `logoDataUrl` update artwork. `idempotencyKey` makes the same update safe to retry.

destinationLocked.description: Lock the destination against future edits

idempotencyKey.description: Prevents duplicate creates or updates on retry (max 64 characters)

logoDataUrl.description: Optional logo as a data URL

reauthToken.description: Step-up reauth token from the app

unlock.description: Set true with reauthToken when the code is destination-locked

name: update_dynamic_qr
title: Change destination
